d: Katie Zacharia's White House story may not be over just yet! After lasting only five days as Donald Trump's press secretary, Zacharia is reportedly making moves for a possible comeback. A New York Post report claims she has been talking about reclaiming the job, even making an appearance at Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort. But there's a catch: anonymous sources close to the president reportedly say Trump has no intention of giving her another chance, with one source claiming he called her a "train wreck." Zacharia has strongly denied the comeback claims, calling the reports fake. So, is this…
